cves.title: Acme Gateway authentication bypass
cves.description: Authentication bypass in the Acme VPN gateway allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access administrative functions.

cves.title: Widget Server SQL injection
cves.description: Improper neutralization of SQL input in Widget Server permits SQL injection through the report parameter.

cves.title: Nimbus Agent remote code execution
cves.description: A deserialization flaw in Nimbus Agent can lead to remote code execution when a crafted management message is processed.

cves.title: Orchid Proxy path traversal
cves.description: Orchid Proxy fails to normalize archive paths, allowing path traversal and arbitrary file overwrite.

cves.title: Delta Appliance buffer overflow
cves.description: A stack-based buffer overflow in the Delta Appliance network parser may cause denial of service or code execution.

cves.title: Helios Console cross-site scripting
cves.description: Stored cross-site scripting in Helios Console allows script execution in an administrator browser.

knowledge.name: SQL Injection
knowledge.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command allows untrusted input to alter database queries.

knowledge.name: Improper Authentication
knowledge.description: Authentication mechanisms fail to prove the claimed identity correctly.

knowledge.name: Path Traversal
knowledge.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory permits traversal outside an intended path.

knowledge.name: SQL Injection
knowledge.description: An attacker injects SQL syntax into an application-controlled database query.

knowledge.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
knowledge.description: Adversaries may exploit a weakness in an internet-facing host or service to gain initial access.

knowledge.name: Password security controls
knowledge.description: Verify that passwords are handled using appropriate authentication security requirements.
